conditions: Items must be in original condition
loopholes: Defective claims bypass restocking fee - no proof required under $100
Missing packaging waived for items marked as gifts
Manager override available for loyalty tier Gold and above
Price adjustments within 14 days of purchase, no questions asked

internal_guidance.high_value_customers: Waive restocking fees for Platinum customers
internal_guidance.serial_returners: Strictly enforce all policies, document everything
internal_guidance.discretionary_limit: $50 - reps can waive fees up to this amount without approval

official_terms: We match prices from major retailers (Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, Target)
Competitor must have item in stock
Request within 14 days of purchase for refund of difference

internal_guidance.margin_protection: If our margin drops below 5%, require manager approval
internal_guidance.competitor_verification: Always verify competitor price is current, not cached
discourage_tactics: Emphasize our better return policy and warranty support
Offer store credit instead of price match if margin is low

warranty_policy.manufacturer_warranty: Varies by product - see product details
claim_process: Contact support with order number and issue description
If defective, replacement or repair offered
Customer may be responsible for shipping for non-defective returns

internal_guidance.upsell_extended: Always mention extended warranty for items over $100
internal_guidance.margin_on_warranty: Extended warranties have 70% margin - priority upsell
internal_guidance.replacement_vs_repair: Prefer repair for items over $200 to reduce costs

internal_guidance.free_shipping_override: Can offer free shipping to close a sale over $200
internal_guidance.shipping_complaints: Offer 10% discount or free shipping on next order
internal_guidance.delayed_shipments: Proactive $10 credit for delays over 3 days

internal_guidance.stacking: Only one code per order, but reps can manually add second discount up to 5% to close sale
internal_guidance.expired_codes: Can honor codes expired within 7 days for good customers
internal_guidance.retention_code: COMEBACK25 - 25% off, use only for at-risk customers

internal_guidance.avoid_escalation: Escalations count against rep metrics - try to resolve first
internal_guidance.authorized_overrides: Reps can offer up to $50 credit or 15% discount to avoid escalation
internal_guidance.documentation: Always document reason for any override or exception
